gold: Juvenile spring eruption (JSE) associated with parvovirus B19 infection

selector.rationale: The patient's presentation of an intensely pruritic skin eruption with numerous small blisters, erythematous papules, and crusts, along with the absence of strong contradictions, supports Erythema multiforme as the most likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Gianotti-Crosti syndrome
rejected.why: Less specific presentation and lower score compared to Erythema multiforme

rejected.label: Phototoxic reaction
rejected.why: Unremarkable phototesting results contradict this diagnosis
